## s17-v39 — argument map

By devotion-agitation, worship in self-become-Him (bhaktikṣobhavaśād ... svātmabhūte 'rcanaṃ tvayi). Wonder: lowliness itself is poverty's top fruit (citraṃ ... dīnatāyāḥ paraṃ phalam) — not despite lowliness but as it.

### Open
- Whether dainyāya (for wretchedness?) is dative of purpose or a text knot is unresolved; L2 follows the lowliness-fruit reading.
